entries.packages/compiler/src/cli/fsm-gen.mjs: the command line of the compiler (bin fsm-gen), which the gen targets of the package Makefiles, make gen-check and the tests of make compiler-test run by path
the golden files of the npm kind, which gen-command.test.mjs of make compiler-test compares by path with the output of fsm-gen
entries.packages/js/src/*.d.ts: the generated declarations of the npm kind, which tsc of make npm-types compiles tests/npm-types/consumer.ts against
entries.tests/npm-types/consumer.ts: the consumer file that tsc of make npm-types compiles against the generated declarations
entries.packages/gui/src/main.mjs: the server of the GUI (bin fsm-gui), which the tests of make gui-test and make gui-browser-test start as a process
entries.packages/gui/client/main.ts: the client entry of the GUI, which hyper-build-assets of make gui-build bundles
entries.packages/gui/scripts/make-favicon.mjs: the program that writes the committed public/favicon.ico, run by hand with node to change the icon
entries.packages/gui/scripts/manual-check.mjs: the driver of the GUI manual check of docs/verification/gui.md, run by hand with node
entries.docs/.vitepress/config.mts: the configuration of the documentation site, which vitepress of make docs-build reads
entries.packages/db/src/models/models.ts: the models that orm-gen generates (npm run gen of packages/db, compared by its tests); MANIFEST_TEXT and MANIFEST_HASH are the documented API of a generated module of orm and stay exported by orm's design
entries.packages/js/examples/model/models.ts: the models that orm-gen generates (make -C packages/js gen, compared by make gen-check); MANIFEST_TEXT and MANIFEST_HASH are the documented API of a generated module of orm and stay exported by orm's design
